input: Find a local astronomy club for monthly star parties

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user's city, region, or country is essential — 'local' means nothing without a location, and it determines which clubs are even findable.
Knowing who the user is (a solo adult, a family with kids, a beginner vs. experienced astronomer) shapes which club culture and age-range is the best fit.
Star parties vary widely — some are casual naked-eye gatherings, others require personal telescopes or have a strong astrophotography focus. Knowing what activities matter keeps the search targeted.
Many clubs charge annual membership fees; knowing whether cost is a factor rules certain clubs in or out.
How far the user is willing to travel to attend events directly limits which clubs are practical options.
Some users want a social/community vibe; others want structured lectures, outreach, or competitive observing programs — this shapes which club culture to prioritise.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — e.g., attending one event, becoming a full member, or just getting a contact name — determines how thorough the search needs to be.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local astronomy club for star parties
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a nearby astronomy club that hosts monthly star party events they can attend.

questions.title: What city or region are you searching in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location so the club search can be geographically scoped.

questions.title: Who will be attending — just you, or others too?
questions.description: Determine whether the club needs to suit a solo adult, a couple, a family with children, or a group, to match the right club demographics.

questions.title: What activities matter most at the star party?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user prioritises naked-eye observing, telescope use, astrophotography, or educational talks to narrow club focus.

questions.title: Is a membership fee acceptable, and if so what range?
questions.description: Establish any budget constraint around annual dues so clubs with high fees can be flagged or excluded.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to attend events?
questions.description: Set a maximum travel radius so only practically reachable clubs are considered.

questions.title: Do you prefer a social club or a more structured learning environment?
questions.description: Understand whether the user values community and casual socialising versus organised programs, lectures, or observing certifications.

questions.title: What does success look like — joining fully or just attending once?
questions.description: Determine the user's end goal so the plan knows whether to stop at finding a contact or go further to securing membership.
